# OpenClaw to EMA Bootstrap

## Goal
Bring the current OpenClaw setup to an EMA-shaped operating point using the vault, QMD habits, and old-system mechanisms.

## Bootstrap principle
Do not wait for the final EMA native UI before becoming useful.
Bootstrap EMA through OpenClaw + vault/QMD + Discord + durable workspace files.

## Minimum bootstrap stack
- OpenClaw as agent runtime and messaging surface
- Discord as command/control surface
- vault/QMD as durable knowledge/query substrate
- workspace files as living EMA scaffold
- chronicle/review/recall write paths
- maintenance/freshness loops

## Bootstrap sequence
1. declare source-of-truth split clearly
2. connect OpenClaw workspace to vault/QMD substrate intentionally
3. define write paths for summaries, chronicle, capture, and memory
4. define query habits across workspace + vault
5. recover old maintenance loops in EMA language
6. define how EMA native UI later sits on top of the same substrate

## Main outcome
An EMA-like system that is already operational and bootstrapable before the full app is complete.
